main_text.l: (Si gemino: HELENÆ corusco Per densa cernat nubila sidere Micare fratres TYNDARIDAS simul) Tunc nauta gaudet:tunc pauores Corde quatit gelido pericli Securus. Ut dum nam caput ilicet NEPTVNVS alto lætior exerit, Lenisque iam mites tridente Cæruleo moderatur vndas. Hinc FAMA curru te celebrem arduo Velox per vrbes TEVTONICAS vehit: Hinc nomen ereptum PALVDI TARTAREÆ tibi surgit ingens. Maiusque cresçet quod tibi creditam MAGNI IVVENTAM reddere PRINCIPIS Doctam PALATINÆ superba Sceptra domus bene ferre curas. Cuius recentes GRYNRADII PIA MENS formAt annos moribus optimis, Culpisque virtutes remotis Perpetuas docet æmulari. AstGente FRANCA nobilis expolit HVTTENVS illum, & rite negotia Tractare monstrat magna, siue

page.notes: Set in roman with small capitals for names and italic for the verse; the italic runs are marked as far as I could judge them. "V dum" is printed with a capital V and read as "Ut dum", since the initial letter is a vowel. "cresçet" is printed with a cedilla-like mark under c; kept as seen. "AstGente" is printed without a space and kept so. Line-end and line-start joins were kept as printed. The page number "* 4" is printed at the foot right.
